notes.en: Experimental local-only recipe for Cave Crave 1.1.4 / 739. Target and Android OBB directory are present in the verified 824. External inventory/sizes: official public catalog snapshot 2026-10-30. APK and all 21 external files must be supplied locally; the main OBB is conservatively required. No official hashes available: import records and later revalidates your file hashes, without declaring them official. No physical test by this fork. External asset-service behavior remains unconfirmed; no synthetic purchase or asset receipt is generated. The 824 minimum selects the audited package; it does not establish that 750 cannot run this game.
notes.de: Experimentelles lokales Rezept für Cave Crave 1.1.4 / 739. APK und alle 21 Zusatzdateien selbst bereitstellen. Keine offiziellen Prüfsummen und kein eigener Hardwaretest; keine Spielbarkeitszusage.
